result.answer: Yes. One specialist, the conformance review, said resend. It only checked that the message is well formed, and it left the question of whether the move still made sense to the other reviews. The Encounter and Impact reviews both said the transfer was superseded. From the impact side, resending would do harm. The bed-management system already shows the patient on WARD-C, bed BAY1-07. That came from a later transfer at 08:45 UTC, applied as version 2. The failed transfer to WARD-B was for 08:20 UTC. It has no receipt, so it never took effect. Resending it now would move the patient backwards to WARD-B, a ward they have already left. The bed board would then show the wrong bed. Pharmacy would send medicines to the wrong ward. Porters would get a task to move a patient who has already moved. Doing nothing keeps the record right at WARD-C, and those systems follow it. Shutter cannot see those systems directly, so these effects are inferred from the bed-management record. If the site kept a complete movement history (W1), the case would go to a person instead. That does not apply here. I cannot resend or change anything myself.

response.content: I submitted the answer: only the conformance review wanted to resend, and resending would move the patient back to a ward they've already left.
